reasoning_content: The /workspace directory is owned by root and the project files there are also owned by root. For ddev to work as the dev user, /workspace needs to be writable. Let me chown the workspace to dev.

action.command: chown -R dev:dev /workspace && chmod 775 /workspace && ls -ld /workspace && sudo -u dev ddev version 2>&1 | head -10

tool_call.name: terminal
